s2kInvoicing.label: S2K invoicing
s2kInvoicing.note: Sep+: $0.10/billable line for entered/fixed only. Auto-add without asking Mina. August recalculated for preview at $0.10/line but not charged per-line.

aiOrdering.label: Ordering
aiOrdering.rateLabel: Sep 2026: 1% of order total (site-built). Oct 2026+: 1% on the first $2,000 of the order + 0.5% on the amount over $2,000.
aiOrdering.basis: All order totals for that client (charged per client)
aiOrdering.note: Site-built / AI draft orders (not saved in a vendor portal): Sep 2026 flat 1% of order total. From Oct 2026, marginal site rate on order total — 1% × min(total, $2,000) + 0.5% × max(total − $2,000, 0). If the order is later entered in a vendor portal, replace the line with the portal bracket rate (fees.aiOrderingPortal); never bill site and portal fees on the same order. Bill on inv_{storeId}_{YYYY-MM}_ordering only (numeric store id, never inv_oakey_…). Auto-add without asking Mina.

setup.label: Setup fee
setup.note: Setup Fees $750 only when Mina explicitly says to charge setup for that store/client. Do NOT auto-add setup.
setup.basis: $750 per store — only when Mina explicitly approves

schedule.label: Schedule fee
schedule.note: Schedule $25/month (separate from Tasks $25). Mina 2026-09-08. Do NOT use $100.

pricebook.label: Pricebook / S2K item edits
pricebook.note: Ampm Pricing: $0.25 per S2K item create/add/edit (Mina set 2026-09-15). Separate from S2K invoicing $0.10/line. Auto-add when Ampm Pricing reports create/add/edit counts. Also covers AI Pricing part 2 (Mina 2026-09-27): $0.25 per item actually changed in S2K from the weekly AI Pricing report (handoff type item_add; charge only after the S2K retail is entered). Billed in addition to aiPriceRecommendation $0.10 when a recommended item is changed.

aiPriceRecommendation.label: AI Pricing recommendations
aiPriceRecommendation.rateLabel: $0.10 per recommended item per store per weekly report
aiPriceRecommendation.basis: $0.10 per item the AI recommends a price increase for, per store, once per weekly AI Pricing report
aiPriceRecommendation.note: AI Pricing part 1 (Mina 2026-09-27 1:51 PM PT, effective 2026-09-27): $0.10 per item the AI recommends a price increase for, per store, counted once per weekly report. Part 2 is the existing pricebook rate ($0.25 per item actually changed in S2K), not a separate rate. An item recommended and then changed in S2K is billed both ($0.10 + $0.25). Cursor runs the weekly AI pricing job and reports both counts per store. Bill each store under its own client/store name, never 'Big Daddy'.

inventoryCount.label: Inventory count
inventoryCount.rateLabel: $50 per department, billed each time we do a department's inventory
inventoryCount.basis: Inventory count: $50 per department, billed each time we do a department's inventory.
inventoryCount.note: Mina rule 2026-09-27: $50 per department, billed each time that department's inventory count is completed for a store. Source: /api/inventory-done (status done only; record id on each line as sourceId/recordId). Billed per store on inv_ _ _inventory under the store's own client name. Lines carry kind inventory_count + store + dept + countDate so the Billing page's /api/inventory-done merge sees them and does not add them again.

aiOrderingPortal.label: Ordering (entered in vendor portal)
aiOrderingPortal.rateLabel: Sep 30–Sep 2026: 1.5% when a bot saves the order in the portal (top-up from 1% site). Oct 2026+: one bracket rate on full order value — 1% if under $1,000; 1.5% if $1,000–$2,000; 1% if over $2,000.
aiOrderingPortal.basis: Vendor portal entry (Customer First, My Coke, etc.) by a bot: Sep 30–Sep 2026 use 1.5% top-up from site 1%; Oct 2026+ use a single bracket rate on the full portal order value.
aiOrderingPortal.note: Mina 2026-09-30: Sep orders keep Sep rules (1% site; portal top-up to 1.5% from 9/30, no double bill). Mina 2026-09-30 PM: Oct 2026+ portal brackets — under $1,000 → 1%; $1,000 through $2,000 → 1.5%; over $2,000 → 1%. Charge each order at one rate only. If a site-built order is later saved in the portal, change that order's fee to the portal bracket (replace the line; do not add a second fee). Bill on inv_{storeId}_{YYYY-MM}_ordering. Bill each store under its own client name.
